MythosMini is a small language model ("mini Fable") built in Python 3.12. This file is the contract for any agent working here. Read it fully, then read `journal.md` before starting any task. Detailed procedures live in `docs/rules/` — read the relevant one before doing that kind of work; they are part of this contract, not optional extras.
